response.original_title: Ed Powers Presents His Favorite New Ends Part 2
response.overview: The New Ends series features a diverse lineup of performers, each bringing a unique personality and story to their appearances with Ed. Maren, a brunette from Germany, makes a memorable debut, while Brianna Banks takes on a new challenge. Jalynn makes her first video appearance after working in still photography.  Misty Rain brings enthusiasm to her first boy-girl scenes, while Victoria Gold is introduced as a confident young performer. Veronica Sage begins a new chapter after ending a long-term relationship. Christina Angel makes her first appearance alongside Jake Steed, with Eric Edwards behind the camera.  Diva, a Polynesian performer, makes her debut, while Kitty Young steps outside her usual persona with a cheerful attitude. The series concludes with veteran performer Kylie Ireland, who returns to explore a new experience and finds a more positive outcome this time around.
